name: pairs_trading_bank_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-fast
thesis: HDFCBANK and ICICIBANK are structurally linked: both are large-cap private banks with overlapping loan books, similar NIM profiles, and high institutional overlap. Their intraday spread (log price ratio) mean-reverts within the session because fundamental news rarely justifies a >1-sigma divergence that persists past lunch. The inefficiency exists because most retail flow is directional, and stat-arb desks focus on multi-day horizons, leaving the intraday spread under-arbitraged. The edge survives because it requires real-time cointegration monitoring and fast two-leg execution that retail traders cannot easily replicate.
stock_filter: Only trade when both legs have avg 1-min volume > 50000 shares in first 30 mins
session: 09:20-15:15 IST (skip first 5 mins for price discovery)

conditions: abs(z_score) NOT expanding for last 3 bars
long.confirmation: z_score crosses above -1.8 from below (momentum turning)

conditions: abs(z_score) NOT expanding for last 3 bars
short.confirmation: z_score crosses below 1.8 from above (momentum turning)

entry.entry_price: market order on both legs simultaneously, limit orders 1 tick inside bid/ask

exit.stop_loss: z_score exceeds 3.5 (spread blowout) OR loss > 0.5% of capital_per_trade
exit.trailing_stop: if z_score crosses 0.5 toward mean, trail at 0.8 sigma from peak reversion
exit.time_stop: close if held > 90 mins without hitting target
exit.signal_exit: hedge_ratio instability: if rolling hedge_ratio changes > 10% in 30 mins, exit

risk.position_sizing: equal INR notional on each leg, adjusted by hedge_ratio

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX < 22; above 22 widen z_score entry to 2.5
filters.volume_filter: both legs must have 1-min volume > 20000 shares at entry bar
filters.trend_filter: NIFTY_BANK not trending > 1% in either direction in last 60 mins
filters.event_filter: skip if either stock has earnings/results within 2 trading days

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — more quant desks entering Indian pairs space; spread may tighten over 6-12 months

weaknesses: Two-leg execution risk: one leg may fill while the other slips, creating unhedged exposure for seconds
Regime breaks: if RBI policy differentially affects one bank (e.g., HDFC merger integration issues), the pair relationship can break for days
Hedge ratio instability intraday can cause false signals if the 120-bar lookback is too short for structural shifts
prior_art: Gatev, Goetzmann & Rouwenhorst (2006) pairs trading framework; adapted for Indian banking sector intraday with z-score entry/exit thresholds similar to Avellaneda & Lee (2010)
notes: Edge math: 0.62 * 45bps - 0.38 * 35bps = 27.9 - 13.3 = 14.6bps gross, costs ~12bps round trip (2*3 slippage + 2.5 STT + 0.5 exchange per leg ~= 12bps), net ~15bps per trade but 2-4 trades/day compounds to ~25bps daily. Half-life filter is critical to avoid pairs that won't revert within the session.
